portal_description:
Red Hat Identity Management (IdM) is a centralized authentication, identity management, and authorization solution for both traditional and cloud-based enterprise environments.

Big Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Pagure #9465: IPA stops working if HTTP/... service principal was created before FreeIPA 4.4.0 and never modified [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-24360)

* Pagure #9517: sidgen plugin does not ignore staged users [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-24363)

* Memory leak in IdM's KDC [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-24366)

* Pagure #9519: session cookie can't be read [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-24370)

* Pagure #9504: Gating-DL1 test failure in test_integration/test_dns_locations.py::TestDNSLocations::()::test_ipa_ca_records [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-24373)

* Pagure #9514: Make sure a default NetBIOS name is set if not passed in by ADTrust instance constructor [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-24376)

* healthcheck reports nsslapd-accesslog-logbuffering is set to 'off' [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-24464)

* tier-1-upstream-dns-locations failed on RHEL8.8 gating [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-25707)

* Pagure #9535: ipa-kdb: Cannot determine if PAC generator is available [rhel-9.3.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-25741)
